entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: An elven druid who built a Selesnyan enclave in the Rubblebelt and was killed by Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Thrill-kill assassin-for-hire of the Rakdos who killed Cecilee.

entities.name: Zi
entities.description: Abandoned Gruul infant adopted by Cecilee and the sole survivor of the attack.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Gruul leader whose clan demanded the baby back.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: Voice of Ravnica that Cecilee followed.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose cultists attacked the vernadi.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Devastated region of Ravnica where Cecilee built her vernadi.

events.summary: Cecilee builds a vernadi in the Rubblebelt as a healing center and forms a bond with the Gruul.
events.quote: she built an outpost of the Conclave called a vernadi

events.summary: Cecilee adopts an abandoned Gruul baby, names him Zi, and refuses to return him to Nikya's clan, ending the Gruul alliance.
events.quote: Cecilee adopted the infant to raise as her own

events.summary: The Rakdos attack the vernadi; Massacre Girl uprooting the guild tree and killing all followers.
events.quote: The Rakdos killed all of Cecilee's followers, sparing her for last.

events.summary: Massacre Girl cuts Cecilee's throat; Zi survives hidden and is rescued by Ruzi.
events.quote: The infant was rescued by Cecilee's brother Ruzi later the same day.

relations.quote: Cecilee was killed by Massacre Girl
Cecilee adopted the infant to raise as her own
